content.text: Digital creators in regions where platforms like Stripe and PayPal are unavailable face a significant challenge: how to set up a fully operational online store. In countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Zimbabwe, the need for a robust, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/sovereign-commerce-infrastructure-digital-creators-what-nobody-tells-9|Sovereign Commerce]] commerce infrastructure is evident. COREMERCH offers solutions tailored for these creators, allowing them to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/build-crypto-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-explained-digital-creators|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s-tanzanian-online-sellers-until-you-2|build]] digital stores that accept crypto payments without relying on conventional payment systems. This guide will walk you through using Supabase as the order database for your digital store and how to deploy COREMERCH's Stack 01 successfully.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms frequently exclude creators in developing regions due to regulatory restrictions and high fees. By leveraging a decentralized infrastructure combining GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments, you regain control over your digital store. This architecture ensures that you own every component after deployment, eliminating dependency on third-party platforms. You can accept crypto payments seamlessly, ensuring that you can transact with customers globally without the barriers imposed by conventional systems.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before diving into deployment, gather the necessary tools. You'll need a GitHub account for hosting your store and a Google account for Apps Script. Familiarize yourself with NOWPayments for processing crypto transactions. Prepare your digital products and have a clear vision of your store layout. With Stack 01, deployment takes approximately 4-6 hours, so ensure you allocate enough uninterrupted time for setup. Review the Sovereign Blueprint for guidance on each step.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, start by deploying your GitHub Pages site. Then, utilize Apps Script to create backend logic that connects to NOWPayments for handling crypto transactions. This integration allows for automatic payment verification and order processing. Ensure your digital products are hosted on a reliable service like Google Drive. Test each component extensively in a development environment before going live to confirm that customers receive their products promptly after payment.
Own your digital store infrastructure without dependency.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up and tested, it’s time to go live. Promote your store through social media and community channels familiar to your target audience. Direct traffic to your GitHub Pages store and monitor the performance closely. When you process your first transaction, ensure that the payment confirmation from NOWPayments triggers the automatic delivery of your digital product. This initial success will validate your setup, providing confidence as you scale your operations.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing transactions, focus on scaling your store. Consider adding more digital products to your catalog and optimizing your marketing strategies. Explore the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for advanced features like end-to-end testing and enhanced security with SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. Continually assess customer feedback to improve user experience and drive sales. Remember, the key to sustainability is owning your infrastructure, giving you the flexibility to adapt as your business grows.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Deploy your store in hours, not weeks.

If you're searching for options like hosting a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, COREMERCH's solutions are designed for you. Consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for an end-to-end tested deployment that enhances your capabilities. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more details.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free by deploying COREMERCH's Stack 01, which utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script for hosting and backend logic. Integrating NOWPayments allows you to process payments without traditional payment platforms.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 is a simplified setup using GitHub Pages and Apps Script, taking 4-6 hours to deploy. Stack 02, however, utilizes Cloudflare Pages and Workers alongside Supabase, allowing for more advanced features and is deployed in 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. GitHub Pages is suitable for simple setups, while Cloudflare Pages offers enhanced performance and features, especially with Stack 02.
What are the costs associated with using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee per transaction, which is competitive compared to traditional payment processors. There are no hidden fees, and you don’t need to undergo KYC processes to use the service.
How do I ensure my digital products are delivered instantly?

To ensure instant delivery of your digital products, integrate NOWPayments with your backend logic using Apps Script. This integration allows for automatic notifications to customers as soon as their payment is confirmed.
